title: Higher-derivative $\mathcal{N}=1$ and $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric Maxwell-Chern-Simons theories at one loop in superspace
summary: We define a higher-derivative generalization of Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory in $\mathcal{N}=1$ and $\mathcal{N}=2$ superspaces. In particular, the chosen higher-derivative operator is a polynomial function of the d'Alembertian of arbitrary degree, and it is introduced exclusively in the gauge sector. The main goal is to explicitly compute the one-loop quantum corrections to the superfield effective potential for these theories.
